_comment: Metres. auto_calibrate=true and calibration_mode=anchor_ranges: anchors measure all three pair distances; the receiver validates the triangle, saves x/y and sets auto_calibrate=false. Until then x/y are placeholders. Anchors and Tag are assumed at the same height (z equal). bias_m corrects Tag ranges only. Set serial_port to Anchor 0's stable by-path USB port when several boards are connected. Add room with x0/y0/x1/y1 to draw a room outline.
